title: Bhagya Debata
desc: Jagadish Mondal, an honest commoner, fights against the unjust practices, corruption and crime prevalent in society in a bid to help the poor and needy, while also taking care of his family.

title: Beder Meye Josna
desc: A prince, bitten by a snake, is saved by the healer Josna, who falls ill in the process. Recovered, she demands his hand in marriage, leading to a royal tug-of-war for love.

title: Swapno
desc: A woman leaves a kind-hearted man owing to a misunderstanding and marries his younger brother. However, it turns out that he is the complete opposite of his elder brother.

title: Suorani Duorani
desc: The king of Kishangarh marries a girl, unaware that she is a demoness. Upon learning the truth about his stepmother, the prince decides to save his father and their kingdom from her evil plans.

title: Ekai Eksho
desc: Ratan, an honest autorickshaw driver, refuses to help a corrupt politician, Pradip Roy, which then leads to a local war. He also ends up falling in love with Jhilik, his daughter.
